# #3695 minimisation ladder
# dxc: <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe
# each candidate is written to scratch-minimise.hlsl and compiled
# 0xE0000001 = assert (crash), 0x80004005 = E_FAIL, an ordinary
# diagnosed error -- NOT a crash

==========================================================================
C1 global-to-global assignment only
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  A = B;
  A[id.xy] = 1.0;
}
--- exit ---
0x80004005  not a crash
--- stdout (first 5 lines) ---

--- stderr ---
scratch-minimise.hlsl:6:7: error: local resource not guaranteed to map to unique global resource.
  A = B;
      ^

==========================================================================
C2 function returns a resource; local; assign to other global
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

RWTexture2D<float4> pick(RWTexture2D<float4> tex) {
  tex[uint2(0,0)] = 1.0;
  return tex;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  RWTexture2D<float4> local = pick(B);
  A = local;
}
--- exit ---
0x80004005  not a crash
--- stdout (first 5 lines) ---

--- stderr ---
scratch-minimise.hlsl:11:7: error: local resource not guaranteed to map to unique global resource.
  A = local;
      ^

==========================================================================
C3 as C2 but the argument is the SAME global that is assigned
==========================================================================

RWTexture2D<float4> A;

  return tex;

  A = local;

==========================================================================
C4 as C3 plus a use of A before the call (GetDimensions)
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

RWTexture2D<float4> pick(RWTexture2D<float4> tex) {
  tex[uint2(0,0)] = 1.0;
  return tex;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  float x, y;
  A.GetDimensions(x, y);
  RWTexture2D<float4> local = pick(A);
  A = local;
}
--- exit ---
0xE0000001  CRASH
--- stdout (first 5 lines) ---

--- stderr ---
Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert

==========================================================================
C5 as C3 plus a store through the OTHER global after the call

--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;

==========================================================================
C6 as C3 but the callee also READS through the parameter
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

RWTexture2D<float4> pick(RWTexture2D<float4> tex, uint2 uv) {
  float4 c = tex[uv];
  tex[uv] = c + 1.0;
  return tex;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  RWTexture2D<float4> local = pick(A, id.xy);
  A = local;
}
--- exit ---
0xE0000001  CRASH
--- stdout (first 5 lines) ---

--- stderr ---
Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert

==========================================================================
C7 as C6 plus a store through the OTHER global after the call
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

RWTexture2D<float4> pick(RWTexture2D<float4> tex, uint2 uv) {
  float4 c = tex[uv];
  tex[uv] = c + 1.0;
  return tex;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  RWTexture2D<float4> local = pick(A, id.xy);
  B[id.xy] = 1.0;
  A = local;
}

Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert

==========================================================================
C8 C3 with a loop in the callee, as in the original
==========================================================================
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main scratch-minimise.hlsl
--- source ---
RWTexture2D<float4> A;
RWTexture2D<float4> B;

float k;
RWTexture2D<float4> pick(RWTexture2D<float4> tex, uint2 uv) {
  float4 c = tex[uv];
  for (float i = 0; i < 6.28; i += k)
    c.r += tex[uv + uint2(i, i)].r;
  tex[uv] = c;
  return tex;
}
[numthreads(8,8,1)]
void main(uint3 id : SV_DispatchThreadID) {
  RWTexture2D<float4> local = pick(A, id.xy);
  A = local;
}
--- exit ---
0xE0000001  CRASH
--- stdout (first 5 lines) ---

--- stderr ---
Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert
